history.position: THIS COURSE TEACHES NO REPAIR HISTORY. The lead's decisions on the engine (the refusal where the canonical trailing trim and the PRMS 3.1.3.1 cumulative peak disagree; the 2011 Guidelines' Table 6.2 read with normal marginals as the Guidelines' own reading; P90 as the low estimate per lib/conventions/percentile.js; no PRMS, FAQ or Guidelines prose quoted) landed before any lesson was written; that is provenance.

regulatoryRule: Every standard, Act, regulation, guide and release is named with its edition or gazette date, its licence and the date read (2026-09-27), printed in digest section 2; quote_check.py pins every file's sha256 prefix and checks the thirteen the draft validation record lists. Public texts (PIA 2021, S.I. No. 37 of 2023, 17 CFR 229.1202, 229.1203 and 210.4-10) are quoted with citation, each quotation in concepts.json and verified against its text. SPE-PRMS 2018 (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), the PRMS FAQs (copyright SPE) and the 2011 Application Guidelines (no licence printed) are cited by section and never quoted; their printed figures are cited as figures and checked in the texts by quote_check.py; gate_no_prms_prose.py refuses any eight-word run of their text in anything a learner reads. The NUPRC release of 1 April 2026 (all rights reserved) is cited for its figures only. No gazetted NUPRC reserves reporting regulation was found; the digest says so.

openReadings.five-year benchmark: met at five years (PRMS 2.1.2.3). Never graded: every field bit-identical under reading_time_frame_exclusive.
openReadings.economic test at zero: an undiscounted net cash flow of exactly 0 is not economic. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_economic_at_zero.
openReadings.economic test and abandonment: the test includes abandonment (PRMS 3.1.1(2)); the producibility determination of 3.1.2.1 excludes it. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_economic_test_before_adr.
openReadings.economic limit rule: the canonical trailing trim, checked against the PRMS 3.1.3.1 cumulative peak and refused where they disagree. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_limit_at_prms_peak (every accepted profile agrees by construction).
openReadings.replacement ratio: every movement other than production over production. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_replacement_additions_only.
openReadings.life index: the closing best estimate over the period's mean annual production. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_life_index_on_low.
openReadings.reconciliation tolerance: a difference equal to the tolerance closes. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_tolerance_exclusive.
openReadings.Monte Carlo low: the 0.1 quantile of the totals (lib/conventions/percentile.js). Never graded: bit-identical under reading_mc_low_at_high_quantile, and on a second seed and draw count.
openReadings.the Guidelines' Table 6.2: read with normal marginals, the Guidelines' own symmetric reading (a lognormal through the same figures gives a sampled P90 of 76.434906 on seed 2011 and 200000 draws). A golden-input reading, printed beside the lognormal one; no field uses it.

scopeSeams.decline curves and type curves: OWNED BY the dca course; this course takes a technical forecast as a stated input and refers there.
scopeSeams.volumetric in-place and recoverable esti: OWNED BY the reservoircalc course (Reservoir Volumetrics).

scopeSeams.distributions, correlation and Monte Car: OWNED BY the uncertainty course; this course applies the canonical sampler to aggregation.
